<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Okay, Brad has checked the calendars and there are no overlapping free times. This means my initial approach of just presenting free slots won't work. I need to take a more proactive approach.

I'll start by finding all the 30-minute slots where Priya and Marcus are *both* free. Then, I will share this smaller list with Brad and ask him to check these specific slots against Elena's and David's calendars. This is more direct and will hopefully help us pinpoint a time more easily. If there are still no common slots, we may need to consider asking partners to reschedule existing meetings, but I will cross that bridge when I come to it.

First, I need to analyze the calendars I have and find the common availability for Priya and Marcus.

Priya's Free Times:

Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30

Marcus's Free Times:
Mon: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30
Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00

Thu: 10:00-10:30
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

Now I will find the intersection of these free times.

Common Free Times for Priya and Marcus:
Mon: 09:00-09:30, 09:30-10:00
Tue: 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30
Fri: 11:00-11:30, 11:30-12:00

I will present this list to Brad and ask him to check these specific times. This is a much more focused request.I see, that's unfortunate. Let's try a more targeted approach. I've found the specific 30-minute slots when both Priya and Marcus are free. Can you please check if any of these work for Elena and David?

*   Mon 09:00-09:30

*   Wed 15:30-16:00

Hopefully one of these will work for them. Let me know.
